name: webservice_body_template_demo
description: 前置 INLINE 使用 XML.stringify 生成包含重复数组标签的完整 SOAP XML，WEBSERVICE 通过 templateParameters 和 ${$.requestXml} 整值引用。

tasks.name: build_soap_xml
tasks.expression: (function () { var payload = $.payload || {}; var patients = Array.isArray(payload.patients) ? payload.patients : []; var patientNodes = patients.map(function (patient) { return { patientCode: patient.patientCode == null ? '' : String(patient.patientCode), name: patient.name == null ? '' : String(patient.name), tags: { tag: Array.isArray(patient.tags) ? patient.tags.map(String) : [] } }; }); return XML.stringify('soap:Envelope', { '@xmlns:soap': 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/', 'soap:Body': { SubmitPatients: { patients: { patient: patientNodes } } } }); })()
